import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h,m,w = params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6],params[7],params[8],params[9]
    s=np.sin(w*t); cc=np.cos(w*t)
    return a + b*t + c*P*np.log(P) + d*np.log(P) + e/P + f*t/P + (g + m*t)*s/P + h*cc/P
